info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan Application By Applicant Id-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows for the removal of a specific loan application associated with an applicant in the system. It facilitates the management of loan applications by enabling authorized users to delete applications by their unique identifiers. Typically utilized by financial institutions or loan processing systems, this function is essential for maintaining accurate records and ensuring data integrity. Use cases include administrative actions to clear outdated or invalid applications, ensuring a streamlined application process for applicants.

delete.summary: Remove a specific applicant from a loan application.
delete.description: This operation allows the deletion of a specific applicant associated with a loan application identified by their unique identifiers. Once deleted, the applicant will no longer be linked to the loan application, which may impact the application's overall assessment.

requestBody.description: This request body represents the required data to delete a specific applicant from a loan application. Ensure that all mandatory fields are properly filled out to process the deletion effectively.

DeleteLoanApplicationByApplicantIdReques.description: The request body for deleting a loan application applicant. This should be a string formatted according to the required specifications.
